fixes.title: Pastes containing a web image inserted nothing at all
fixes.problem: Pasting anything that included an image with a web address, such as a web article with a photo or content copied from another rich text editor with an uploaded image, inserted nothing. The text, lists and tables around the image were all lost.
fixes.cause: The `summernote.paste` handler returned early whenever `/]+src=["']https?:\/\//i` matched the clipboard HTML, on the assumption that `onImageUpload` would handle it. `onImageUpload` only fires for image files, never for `` tags in HTML, so the whole paste was dropped after `e.preventDefault()`.
fixes.change: The early return is removed. Such pastes now go through `buildInsertNodes`/`cleanHtml` like any other HTML. The new paste-time filter in `cleanHtml` keeps images with http(s) or data: sources.
tests: image manipulation › http(s) image in pasted HTML survives paste-time cleaning
image manipulation › images nested inside pasted tables and lists are retained
mixed-content pastes › image directly before a table, table trailing: both retained, caret below the table
mixed-content pastes › multiple tables and images in one paste: all retained in document order
RTE to RTE copy/paste › content containing an uploaded (https) image pastes fully — text and image
web page paste › article containing an https image pastes fully — text, link and image
fixes.shot: web page paste › article containing an https image pastes fully — text, link and image

fixes.title: Pastes with embedded base64 images never saved to Appian
fixes.problem: Content with embedded images, such as from modern Word or copied from another rich text editor, showed up correctly in the editor but was never saved. Users also saw save time out when they pasted text while an image was still uploading.
fixes.cause: Images that arrive as `data:` URIs inside clipboard HTML had no upload path because `onImageUpload` only fires for files. `setAppianValue` refuses to save while base64 content is present, so these pastes never saved.
fixes.change: After inserting the paste and calling `removePasteArtifacts`, the handler scans `.note-editable` for images where `isImageNewBase64` is true and `window.connectedSystem` is set. For each one it adds the `loading` class, calls `uploadBase64Img`, swaps in the returned document URL, removes `loading` and calls `setAppianValue`. Images already marked `loading` are skipped, so no image is uploaded twice.
tests: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian
image manipulation › base64 image in pasted HTML: save waits for the upload, then goes through
RTE to RTE copy/paste › base64 image embedded in copied RTE content is retained and uploaded
paste robustness › pasting text while an image upload is in flight: both survive, save settles once
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian

fixes.title: Multi-block pastes kept only the first block
fixes.problem: When users pasted HTML that had line breaks between blocks, such as a typical web article, only the heading or first block appeared and everything after it was lost. Spaces between inline elements were also lost.
fixes.cause:
Whitespace-only text nodes between blocks, such as the newlines between `

` and `

`, were inserted through `summernote("insertNode")`, which put the caret in the wrong place and dropped every later block. Separately, the first-pass loop skipped all whitespace-only text nodes (`node.textContent.trim()`), which removed real spaces between inline elements.
fixes.change: New `buildInsertNodes` keeps every text node in the first pass. It then filters out whitespace-only text nodes that sit next to a block element on either side, using `isBlockElement`/`BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX`. Whitespace between two inline nodes is kept.
tests: mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained

fixes.title: Multi-line plain text pasted as a single line
fixes.problem: Plain text with several lines, from Notepad, a terminal or a PDF, pasted as one run-together line. When pasted in the middle of a paragraph, the lines came out in the wrong order and the caret ended up in the wrong place.
fixes.cause:
The plain-text clipboard was parsed by `DOMParser` as a single text node, so its newlines collapsed when inserted. No conversion to `
` happened on the paste path.
fixes.change:
If the clipboard content does not start with `<`, the handler runs it through `cleanHtml(clipboardHtml, true)`, whose raw-text branch turns newlines into `
`. If the result contains `
`, it is wrapped in a single `

` so it is inserted as one block, because bare text plus `
` sequences confuse `insertNode`. Single-line text stays unwrapped so it is inserted inline.
tests: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text pasted mid-paragraph: following text pushed below, caret before it
paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text: spacing correct AND caret ends at the end of the pasted text
RTE to RTE copy/paste › plain-text paste converts newlines to line breaks
PDF paste › multi-paragraph text: all paragraphs retained with line breaks
PDF paste › bulleted list: bullet glyphs and every item retained on separate lines
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text pasted mid-paragraph: following text pushed below, caret before it

fixes.title: Content after a pasted table landed inside its last cell
fixes.problem: When a paste had inline content (such as an image or text) right after a table, that content ended up inside the table's last cell instead of below the table, so the pasted content was out of order.
fixes.cause: `insertNode` leaves the caret inside a just-inserted table's last cell, and a position directly after the table gets moved back into the cell. Summernote's `insertNode` reads its internal `lastRange`, not the live selection.
fixes.change:
In the insert loop, when a table is followed by an inline node (checked with `isBlockElement`), the handler reuses or creates an empty `


` after the table. It moves the selection to offset 0 of that paragraph and calls `summernote("editor.setLastRange")`, so the next node is inserted below the table.
tests: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order

fixes.title: Unloadable images from Word and relative URLs were saved broken
fixes.problem: Images pasted from Word or Excel (temporary `file:///` files on the copier's machine) and images with relative URLs were kept and saved to Appian as permanently broken images.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` had no check on image sources, so any `` that passed the tag allowlist was kept whatever its `src` was.
fixes.change: New `cleanHtml` Step 6.5 runs only when `isPartialHtml` is true (paste-time cleaning). It removes any `` whose `src` is not `http(s):` or `data:`. Surrounding text is kept, and stored content is not changed.
tests: MS Word paste › embedded image: surrounding text retained; dead file:/// reference does not reach Appian
web page paste › relative image URL in pasted HTML is dropped, surrounding text kept
Excel paste › range copied with an embedded chart: table retained, dead temp-file image dropped
fixes.shot: MS Word paste › embedded image: surrounding text retained; dead file:/// reference does not reach Appian

fixes.title: Images copied with an image file pasted twice
fixes.problem: Copying an image (for example from a PDF viewer) and pasting it inserted it twice. Outlook-style copies, which put text plus an inline image file on the clipboard, also produced a duplicate image.
fixes.cause: Summernote's own paste path inserts clipboard image files through `onImageUpload`, and the handler also inserted the HTML version's ``. The upstream skip only matched https `` tags, so it did not catch non-https `` tags such as Outlook's `cid:` references.
fixes.change: The handler checks `clipboardData.files`. If files are present and the HTML has no visible text (tags, `DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN` matches and ` ` removed), it returns and lets `onImageUpload` handle it. If there is text, the HTML still goes through, and its unloadable `cid:` `` is removed by `cleanHtml` Step 6.5, so the image arrives only once.
tests: PDF paste › image copied from a PDF viewer pastes exactly once
web page paste › Outlook-style copy (text plus inline image file): the text is not lost
fixes.shot: PDF paste › image copied from a PDF viewer pastes exactly once

fixes.title: Word paste added line breaks inside sentences
fixes.problem: Text pasted from Word got extra line breaks wherever the source HTML had formatting newlines, splitting single sentences across lines. A Word Shift+Enter became a double line break.
fixes.cause:
In `cleanHtml`, the partial-HTML branch turned any remaining `\n` in clipboard HTML into `
`, even though those newlines are only source formatting.
fixes.change: That branch now turns all CR/LF into spaces, because real line breaks already appear as tags. The Word list cleanup regex now also handles a bare `\r` (`/[\r\n]+/g`).
tests: MS Word paste › REGRESSION (original reported bug): source newlines between inline spans stay one sentence

MS Word paste › hard returns (Shift+Enter) become a single
, not extra paragraphs
fixes.shot: MS Word paste › REGRESSION (original reported bug): source newlines between inline spans stay one sentence

fixes.title: Script and style contents leaked into pasted text
fixes.problem: Pasting HTML that contained a script left the script's code as visible text in the editor, and content after it could be lost.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` Step 2 removed only the tags that were not allowed, so the text inside `<script>`, `<style>`, `<iframe>` and similar tags was left behind.
fixes.change: New `cleanHtml` Step 0 removes these tags together with their contents using `DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN`, and removes lone or self-closing forms using `DANGEROUS_TAGS_SELF_CLOSING_PATTERN`. Both are built from `DANGEROUS_TAGS_WITH_CONTENT`.
tests: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute
fixes.shot: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute

fixes.title: Code blocks from web pages pasted onto one line
fixes.problem: Pasting a code block from a web page joined all of its lines into one line.
fixes.cause: `<pre>` is not in `ALLOWED_TAGS`, so its structure is removed, and the newlines inside it were flattened together with the rest of the clipboard HTML.
fixes.change:
Before the newline flattening, `cleanHtml` turns newlines inside each `
` block into `
` and wraps the block in `
`, so `insertNode` keeps every line.
tests: web page paste › code block: line breaks inside <pre> content are preserved
fixes.shot: web page paste › code block: line breaks inside <pre> content are preserved

fixes.title: Pastes left stray empty paragraphs behind
fixes.problem: Pressing Enter and then pasting left an extra blank line at the caret. Repeated pastes added more and more blank paragraphs at the end of the content.
fixes.cause:
Upstream did nothing to remove the empty `


` paragraphs that Summernote leaves around inserted content.
fixes.change: Before inserting, the handler records the empty paragraph at the caret (`findCaretEmptyParagraph`) and the blank paragraphs already at the end (`snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs`). After inserting, `removePasteArtifacts` removes the caret paragraph if it is still blank, and removes new trailing blank paragraphs while keeping the ones that were there before.
tests: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › Enter-then-paste leaves no stray empty paragraph at the caret
paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs
fixes.shot: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs

fixes.title: Pasted tables left two blank lines and a misplaced caret
fixes.problem: Pasting a table in the middle of content left two blank lines below it. After a paste ending in a table, the caret looked stuck at the table's edge instead of on the line below.
fixes.cause:
The trailing-table step always inserted a new `


`, even when splitting the destination paragraph had already left an empty one there. `insertNode` also left the selection after that paragraph's `
`.
fixes.change: If the node after the trailing table already passes `isEmptyParagraph`, it is reused instead of adding another. The selection is then explicitly collapsed to offset 0 of that paragraph.
tests: paste at cursor position › table pasted mid-content leaves exactly one blank line before the following text
RTE to RTE copy/paste › caret lands on the blank line below a pasted table, ready to type
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › table pasted mid-content leaves exactly one blank line before the following text

fixes.title: Screenshots pasted even when images are disabled
fixes.problem: With `allowImages` set to false, pasting a screenshot still inserted and uploaded the image.
fixes.cause: `allowImages` only hid the toolbar picture button and affected HTML cleaning. The `onImageUpload` callback ignored it.
fixes.change: `onImageUpload` now returns immediately when `window.allowImages` is false.
tests: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false
fixes.shot: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false

fixes.title: Content-too-big error flashed during image uploads
fixes.problem: While an image was uploading, the maximum-size validation error briefly appeared and then disappeared.
fixes.cause: `validate` measured `getEditorContents().length`, which included the uploading image's large base64 data URI. Base64 is never saved.
fixes.change: `validate` replaces `src="data:..."` / `src='data:...'` with `src=""` before comparing the length against `maxSize`. The `getEditorContents` call stays inside the `!isReadOnly()` check.
tests: editor lifecycle › maxSize validation does not flash while an image uploads

fixes.title: Strikethrough from web pages was lost on paste
fixes.problem: Strikethrough text copied from web pages or the editor itself lost its strikethrough when pasted.
fixes.cause: `ALLOWED_TAGS` included only the older `<strike>` tag, so the `<s>` tag that modern pages use was stripped.
tests: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained
RTE to RTE copy/paste › formatting gauntlet: every format alone and in stacked combinations survives, and saves
fixes.shot: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained

fixes.title: Some disallowed attributes and multi-line comments survived cleaning
fixes.problem: Word's unquoted attributes (such as `border=1 cellspacing=0`) and single-quoted attributes could get past the attribute allowlist, and HTML comments that span several lines were not removed.
fixes.cause: In `cleanHtml` Step 3, the attribute regex `/([\w-]+)="[^"]+?"/g` only matched double-quoted, non-empty values. The Step 4 style lookahead required `"`. The Step 7 comment regex `/<!--.*?-->/g` could not match across newlines.
fixes.change: Step 3 now matches `attr="v"`, `attr='v'` and unquoted `attr=v`. Step 4 accepts either quote in its lookahead. Step 7 uses `/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g`.

otherChanges: Moved paste handler logic into named helpers (`buildInsertNodes`, `isBlockElement`, `hasBlankText`, `isEmptyParagraph`, `findCaretEmptyParagraph`, `snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs`, `removePasteArtifacts`), and moved `BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX` and the dangerous-tag regexes up to module-level constants.

Updated existing `cleanHtml` unit tests for the changed behavior: newlines in HTML become spaces, whitespace between tags collapses to a single space, script/style are stripped with their contents, `<s>` is kept, and the expected output for attributes containing `>` changed.

Added unit test file `cleanHtml.imageSources.test.js` (removes `file:///`, `javascript:` and src-less images) and handler-level unit test file `pastePlainTextLineBreaks.test.js`; replaced the old 'img skipped' paste-flow test.
Ran Prettier over `index.js` and the test files; reworded and expanded comments.
